QuestInfo.name: The Scent of a Kobold
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Tom's mom for more info about #b#o9390915##k.
QuestInfo.1: Tom's mom said she could make a fragrance to disguise you as one of the kobolds if you bring the ingredients.\r\nBring her 10 #t4034001:#, 10 #t4034003:#, and 10 #t4034004:# items.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the ingredients to Tom's mom.

1.msg: (You explain how you couldn't get in.)

2.msg: Ah I see. I somehow got the impression that the kobolds used special smells for their powers.

3.msg: Where can I find that scent?

4.msg: If you collect kobold things, I can make you a powerful kobold scent. Not for the faint of heart, mind you.\nSo long as you smell like one of them you'll be able to get through.

no.0: Well, you just let me know if you need that perfume.

1.0: Back already? You're almost as quick as my baby boy, Tom!

yes.0: Just give me a second to whip it up...

item.0: That's not enough... Bring me more!
